answer_1.quote: We study how to generate substitutes via paraphrase modeling... Specifically, we design two decoding strategies that center on lexical variations of the target word during decoding and propose a substitute candidate ranking strategy by utilizing the newest text generation evaluation metrics.
answer_1.outputs: list of substitute word candidates for a target word in context

answer_2.quote: We use BARTScore and BLEURT to compute the relationship between the original sentence and the updated sentences... For evaluating LS07 and CoInCo, we use the official metrics "best", "best-m", "oot", "oot-m" as well as Precision@1 (P@1). In SwordS we use the harmonic mean of precision and recall (F_a, F_c).
